name: Novelty Score Sampler
description: Selects experimental conditions based on dissimilarity to reference conditions and returns both the conditions and their dissimilarity scores.

novelty_score_sampler.name: num_samples
novelty_score_sampler.description: Number of novel samples to select from the condition pool. If not specified, returns all conditions sorted by novelty.

novelty_score_sampler.name: metric
novelty_score_sampler.description: Distance metric for measuring dissimilarity between conditions.

novelty_score_sampler.name: integration
novelty_score_sampler.description: Method for combining pairwise distances into overall dissimilarity score.

inputDataType.name: conditions
inputDataType.description: Pool of candidate experimental conditions to evaluate.

inputDataType.name: reference_conditions
inputDataType.description: Existing experimental conditions to compare against.

outputDataType.name: conditions
outputDataType.description: Selected experimental conditions with dissimilarity scores column included.
